name: Khrono the Timewinder
bio: Through his Arcana, Khrono did what many Magi thought impossible – he managed to leap into the gap between time. Unfortunately, entering this literal time tunnel was a one-way trip. While his physical body is trapped at the crossroads of infinity, he can project his raw magical form back into our reality, at any time he desires.

Creates the Infinity Domain in a 10m radius around the ally with the highest MAX HP. The Infinity Domain lasts 7s and covers a 360° zone.
All allies in the Infinity Domain receive increased [25% Move SPD Up], [15% Combo SPD Up], [15% Skill SPD Up].
All enemies in the Infinity Domain receive decreased [25% Move SPD Down], [15% Combo SPD Down], [15% Skill SPD Down].
All Infinity Domain effects cannot be resisted or removed and affect each target's stats directly — they are not buffs or debuffs, but the effects will stack on top of any buffs or debuffs.
